demo.cliff: an effect belongs to the Item that carries it
teaches: `subType: "trinket"` is the sub-type for a thing with no mechanical weight of its own.
An Active Effect on an Item transfers to whoever holds it — there is no pack of loose effects and there should not be.
`transfer: true` and `disabled: false` are what make it live; `flags.mgt2.suspended` is the referee's pause, kept apart from `disabled`.
demo.trap: The change is aimed at `system.modifiers.check.custom`, a stored accumulator, so `phase: "initial"` is right. Aim one at a derived value in that phase and the next `prepareDerivedData` overwrites it — see the `Demo — Standing DM` pair.

system.description: A brass mooring tag off a boat that sank without her. Its owner will tell you it works.

effects.name: Demo — Held for luck
effects.description: A referee-invented trinket effect: +1 on every check while it is carried.
